stock.description: Honworld Group Limited operates as an investment holding entity, primarily involved in the production and distribution of cooking wine and various other seasoning products throughout the People's Republic of China. The company markets these items under its established Lao Heng He brand, with offerings including staple condiments like soy sauce, vinegar, soybean paste, and fermented bean curd. Additionally, Honworld Group engages in the wholesale trade of these food seasonings. The company was founded in 2012 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Huzhou, PRC.
